hooks.name: API Fallback Validation
hooks.description: Ensures all API calls have proper error handling and fallbacks so the app degrades gracefully.

action.prompt:
An API wrapper file in src/lib/api/ was just saved. Verify its resilience:

1. Verify every fetch call is wrapped in try/catch.
2. Verify there is a fallback return value (never an unhandled undefined/null).
3. Verify PAGASA calls have an Open-Meteo fallback path.
4. Verify all API responses include a lastUpdated timestamp.
5. Verify caching logic exists (minimum 15-minute cache).

For any check that fails, add a TODO comment at the exact violation point in the file describing what's missing. Then report a short summary of which checks passed and which failed.
